eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a set of WhatsApp sales, marketing, support, and product-use guides/case studies, not engineering or product-build posts.

claygent-argon-B.reasoning: I treated rasayel.io as the requested WhatsApp sales platform, not the separate Dubai logistics company whose report identifies rasayel.com. The profile for rasayel.io reports one Seed round in 2022, with PitchBook dating it to February 2022; that is outside the 18-month window. The latest dated product changelog item is April 28, 2026, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026. Current hiring was checked against the live careers listing.

hq_location.notes: Cork is identified as Rasayel’s location/HQ by Viber’s partner listing and Craft; Tracxn reports Dublin, so the city is given with medium confidence.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product/help articles and API references.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round is the February 2022 Seed round, before May 9, 2025; the October 2026 Dubai/rasayel.com report concerns a different company.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and Tracxn identify 2022; some company aggregators report 2020, so this is stated with medium confidence.

last_funding.notes: The latest reported round is Seed in February 2022; the amount is undisclosed. The schema requires a number, so 0 is a neutral placeholder and does not mean the company raised nothing.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest dated changelog update is April 28, 2026; the blog index has no later dated launch announcement.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Start, Grow, and Enterprise plans.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 16 employees in June 2026 and LinkedIn reports 15, both within 11-20.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-jobs board lists only a Senior Software Engineer role, not SDR/BDR or account executive.

model_provider.notes: The public Support AI documentation and privacy/tools disclosure reviewed do not identify the underlying AI model or provider.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in Rasayel-published customer success stories.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current open-jobs board lists only Senior Software Engineer; no listed title contains an AI/ML/data-science role keyword.

compliance_certs.notes: Rasayel has a public security policy, but it names none of the listed certifications as its own.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Rasayel’s public integration documentation names these systems.

product_one_liner.value: Rasayel helps B2B sales teams manage WhatsApp conversations, automate follow-ups, and sync them with their CRM.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full small team page lists the cofounders as CEO and COO; their profiles place their Rasayel tenures before the 12-month window, and no departure was found.
